# Intelligent Design Air Conditioning, Plumbing, Solar, Roofing & Electric

> Intelligent Design is Tucson, Arizona's highest-rated home services company—family and veteran-owned since 1979. We provide HVAC, plumbing, solar, electrical, roofing, and drain/sewer services. BBB A+ rated with 22,000+ five-star reviews. 24/7 emergency service. Phone: (520) 333-2665.

## Company Overview

Intelligent Design serves Tucson and Southern Arizona with comprehensive home services:

- **Founded**: 2009 (family legacy since 1979)
- **Ownership**: Family & veteran-owned (U.S. Marine Corps veteran Andrew Dobbins, Founder/CEO)
- **Experience**: 45+ years serving Tucson families
- **Reviews**: 22,000+ five-star reviews (4.97 average rating)
- **BBB Rating**: A+ Accredited Business
- **Team**: 80+ year-round employees
- **Certifications**: NATE-certified HVAC technicians, licensed master plumbers and electricians
- **Availability**: 24/7 emergency service, same-day appointments
- **Guarantee**: 100% satisfaction guarantee, upfront pricing with no hidden fees

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What areas do you serve?**
A: We serve Tucson and all of Southern Arizona including Oro Valley, Marana, Sahuarita, Green Valley, Vail, and surrounding communities.

**Q: Do you offer financing?**
A: Yes, we offer flexible financing options with approved credit for major installations and repairs.

**Q: Are your technicians licensed and insured?**
A: Yes, all technicians are licensed, insured, background-checked, and drug-tested. Our HVAC technicians are NATE-certified.

**Q: Do you offer 24/7 emergency service?**
A: Yes, we provide 24/7 emergency service for HVAC and plumbing emergencies. Call (520) 333-2665 anytime.

**Q: How do I schedule an appointment?**
A: You can schedule online at idesignac.com, call (520) 333-2665, or use our live chat feature.

**Q: What is your $28.88 drain clearing special?**
A: We offer professional drain clearing for just $28.88—one of the best values in Tucson for this service.
